eligibility.open_enrollment: Children league age 4–7 can register regardless of where they live or attend school.
eligibility.older_players: Players who have played continuously with Fishkill Little League since league age 7 and siblings of qualifying players may also be eligible
eligibility.continued_play: If your child joins Fishkill Little League by league age 7, they can keep playing with us as they get older by registering and participating every spring without a break, subject to Little League’s other eligibility requirements.
eligibility.in_boundary: Players can qualify if their home or school is within Fishkill Little League’s boundary.
